description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score percentages for different configurations of the MADLLM model across five datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 score percentage, ranging from 80% to 100%, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. The chart includes three sets of bars, each representing a different configuration of the MADLLM model: MADLLM, MADLLM without feature embedding, and MADLLM without skip embedding. The bars are color-coded, with MADLLM in green, MADLLM without feature embedding in purple, and MADLLM without skip embedding in orange. The F1 scores for each configuration vary across the datasets, with the highest scores generally observed for the MADLLM configuration. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on certain bars.
